directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools: the contact sheets a film's scripts made
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: make-a-contact-sheet-of-pictures-or-video-frames: a film's picture-grid and frames-at-times contact sheets, moved byte for byte

preserve: cells of one width and a 16:9 shape, each picture scaled to the cell's width with Lanczos and cut to its middle when taller
the label in its strip under the picture, padding round and between the cells
rows = ceil(pictures / columns); the sheet is saved as JPEG
the old command line out.jpg cols cellw "label|path" ... still makes the same sheet
allowed_deltas: one JSON request in and one answer out; every value the script fixed (font file, label size and colour, background, padding, quality) is a field of the request with the old value as its default, except the font, which the caller names
the stretch-and-label-above layout of the film's round-2 sheet (file names above, no padding, the first picture's shape) as request fields: that older copy is not ported separately
the frames-at-a-rate kind: the ffmpeg tile sheets the film's watch.sh and sheets6_r8.sh made, with their numbers as fields
banned_substitutions: a font path written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
